key_responsibilities: Configure Dependabot to check for updates to GitHub Actions workflows (package-ecosystem: github-actions).
Specify the repository scope for update checks (directory: /).
Schedule update checks to run on a weekly interval.
Limit the number of open Dependabot pull requests to a maximum of 10.
notable_patterns: Applies a cap on concurrent open pull requests (open-pull-requests-limit)
overview.summary: This file is a Dependabot configuration (version 2) that instructs Dependabot to manage dependency updates for GitHub Actions used in the repository. It targets the repository root (directory: /) and runs on a weekly schedule to check for new updates. The configuration also limits the number of simultaneously open Dependabot pull requests to 10.
